remarks: Highest & Best By Tuesday (Feb.17th) @ Noon.This home will feel like love at first sight. Only a short 5 minute walk to downtown New Canaan and train, this fully renovated townhouse (end-unit) has 3 bedrooms, 2.5 baths and 2,232 sqft, including a lower level that walks out to a private patio. Picture yourself stepping into the foyer each day - warm light, hardwood floors, and a dining room perfect for dinners with friends or weekend breakfasts. The kitchen is the kind you'll actually want to cook in: top tier appliances, bright white countertops and plenty of storage so everything has a place. The living room is tucked away just enough to be a quiet spot for reading, movie nights, or a cup of coffee in the morning. All three bedrooms are upstairs. The primary is calm and roomy with an en-suite featuring a floor to ceiling shower and heated bathroom floors. The two guest bedrooms are generous in size with plenty of closet space. If you value thoughtful updates, cozy corners, and being steps from town, this might be the perfect option for you. As another added amenity, the next owner will be able to look forward to brand new siding all throughout the entire exterior of the home as part of the upcoming complex initiative - this is already paid for by the current owners, no additional expense!
